subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: Current source proves the suppression path, but the active union_id fix depends on an identity source the reporter says bot/v3/info does not provide, so automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Refresh the linked PR or replace it only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Document Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Multi-Bot Work
options.body: Use this issue as canonical context for a larger Feishu identity and routing design if maintainers want to solve admission, bot visibility, and session scope together.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR or replace it only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the active linked PR as a Feishu identity-surface conflict and have recent commits in the affected Feishu runtime paths.
